verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server through which an agent can build audiences and then create or manage syncs to activate them, for example creating a cart-abandon audience and syncing it to Braze. Its documented REST API covers syncs, models, sources and destinations, but not audiences explicitly. Agent querying of customer data is only implied by 'understand your customer schema' and segment exploration, and docs say audiences cannot be created until schema configuration is complete, with audience building otherwise described as a no-code UI. missing for 10: documented direct customer-data querying by an agent, audience endpoints in the REST API, evidence that schema setup can be done without the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop

citations.quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.
All customers: Understand your customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage syncs, and create syncs from templates.
Hightouch exposes a REST API that lets users interact with resources like syncs, models, sources, and destinations.
